introduction.headline: Mosquito Protection Engineered for Hunters
introduction.subtitle: Synthetic, plant-derived compounds mask chemical cues for up to 720 hours of consistent protection without harsh DEET odors.
introduction.body: Mosquitoes and biting insects coincide with peak spring and early fall hunting seasons. Odin's Citronella Mosquito & Insect Repellent provides hunters with a practical, scent-smart solution. The synthetic, oil-based liquid creates a protective perimeter barrier when applied to foliage, brush, or ground cover around stands or blinds. With potential duration of up to 720 hours of continuous exposure, the formula supports reduced reapplication time compared to traditional options that last approximately 20 minutes. Formulated with a proprietary blend of plant-derived compounds including citronellal and geraniol (an EPA-registered biopesticide), it masks the CO₂, lactic acid, and octenol cues mosquitoes use to locate hosts. The milder scent profile avoids the strong chemical odors associated with DEET that deer can detect at distance. Pairs effectively with Odin's Citronella Scent Beads for layered coverage and is legal in all 50 states.

detection.headline: How Mosquitoes Locate Hosts — Three-Stage Targeting Process
detection.body: Mosquitoes use a sophisticated multi-stage system. Stage 1 (long range): CO₂ from breath detected from over 150 feet away. Stage 2 (medium range): lactic acid and octenol from skin and sweat, with output increasing during physical activity such as hiking to setups. Stage 3 (close range): body heat and moisture. Odin's Citronella disrupts Stages 1 and 2 by masking these chemical signatures through consistent vapor release from treated surfaces.

items.q: What is the best bug repellent for deer hunting?
items.a: The best bug repellent for deer hunting is one that effectively repels mosquitoes without alerting game. Odin's citronella scent beads are DEET-free, scent-smart, and deploy around your position rather than on your body — creating a repellent zone without contaminating your clothing or skin with detectable chemicals.

items.q: Can deer smell DEET mosquito spray?
items.a: Yes. DEET-based mosquito repellents produce a strong chemical odor that deer and other game animals can detect at significant distances. Citronella-based repellents like Odin's produce a milder, naturally derived scent that is far less alarming to game.

items.q: Is citronella safe for skin contact?
items.a: Citronella oil is registered with the EPA as a biopesticide with a non-toxic mode of action. Odin's citronella beads are designed to be deployed around your position rather than applied to skin, which eliminates the skin-contact question entirely. The liquid can be spritzed on foliage and on the ground. If you do get it on your hands, it's plant-derived and washes off easily.

items.q: Does citronella repellant scare deer away while hunting?
items.a: No. Our synthetic scent and natural delivery methods are naturally occurring material, and we have not found any concern shown by deer.

items.q: Is there a cover scent for spring turkey hunting?
items.a: Yes, but not in the same way most hunters consider using cover scents, though it is really doing the same thing. For deer hunting we want to mask the human odor in our gear and the human aromas coming off of us at all times. Put the smell of a forest floor out as the most dominant aroma. The goal for Citronella is to keep them from finding you in the first place!

Odin's Citronella doesn't kill mosquitoes — it makes you invisible to them. The active compounds (citronellal, citronellol, and geraniol) mask the CO₂ and lactic acid signatures mosquitoes use to locate you. Unlike a candle that dissipates quickly or a spray that evaporates in 20 minutes, Odin's biodegradable polymer beads release these compounds continuously — the same slow-release technology we use in our hunting scent products. You're deploying a sustained repellent zone, not reapplying every 20 minutes.

items.q: How do mosquitoes find you in the first place?
items.a: Mosquitoes locate hosts using a combination of carbon dioxide from your breath (detected from over 150 feet away), lactic acid and octenol from your skin and sweat, and body heat at close range. Physical activity increases lactic acid production, which is why mosquitoes are especially aggressive after you've been hiking or setting up camp. Citronella-based repellents work by masking these chemical signals.

items.q: What can I use to keep mosquitoes away while turkey hunting?
items.a: Put 2–3 tablespoons of Citronella beads in a sheer bag and hang it from your clothing. If you're in a stationary position, squirt some Citronella liquid on the foliage near you to add more scent barrier around your setup.

items.q: Does citronella work in a hunting blind?
items.a: It works exceptionally well. The enclosed or semi-enclosed space concentrates the citronella scent, creating a stronger repellent zone than you'd get in open air. Hang a mesh bag of beads from the ceiling or a corner of the blind. Customers have reported coming back days later to find the blind completely mosquito-free. One mesh bag in a blind can last an entire season.

items.q: Why do Odin's citronella beads last longer than sprays or candles?
items.a: Traditional citronella products — candles, sprays, and lotions — rely on evaporation to disperse active compounds, which is why they wear off in 20 minutes to a few hours. Odin's biodegradable polymer beads encapsulate the citronella compounds and release them gradually through controlled diffusion. The result is sustained, hands-free mosquito protection for the equivalent of 30 days, not 30 minutes.

items.q: How long do Odin's citronella beads last?
items.a: Odin's citronella beads use the same 30-day biodegradable polymer technology as our hunting scent products. Once deployed, they continue repelling mosquitoes for the equivalent of 30 days.

items.q: Can I reuse the citronella beads?
items.a: Yes! The equivalent of 30 days is 720 hours. If the beads are in a mesh bag, put the bag in a Ziplock — roll it tight and seal it — and they'll be ready next time you need them. They don't lose potency when not exposed to air.

items.q: When would I need mosquito protection for 30 days?
items.a: Customers have hung a mesh bag of Citronella beads in their hunting blind, come back the next day or next week, and found zero mosquitoes waiting. Another customer hangs them in his garage workshop — no mosquitoes to bother him while he works. The 30-day life means you deploy once and forget about it.

items.q: What if the mosquitoes are really bad?
items.a: If the beads and the liquid don't do it… go inside and drink a beer.
